# CANDIDATE: VIX_FILTER_FOR_BEAR_PUTS

**Filed:** 2026-07-23  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Adding a VIX >= 20 filter to bear put entries will avoid losses on losing J days where VIX is low (indicating complacency) while preserving winner day entries where VIX is elevated during bearish rejection. This targets the 06-26 wrong-way class (bear PUTs in uptrends) observed in STRUCTURE_VETO_DIR_VS_TREND, which often occur in low-VIX environments.

## Mechanism

- Entry trigger: BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON setup fires (existing trigger logic unchanged)
- New filter: skip entry if VIX < 20.0 at the trigger bar timestamp
- Exit logic: unchanged (chart-stop primary, chandelier profit-lock, TP1 at +50%, runner, time stop 15:50 ET)
- Applies only to bear put side (side=='P'); bull call entries unaffected
- Implemented as a pre-entry check in `engine_cli.decide_payload` after `_derive_routing`, gated on `gate_params["vix_bear_filter_enabled"]`

## OP-20 disclosures

1. **Account-size assumption:** qty=28 requires $25K+; $1K paper ~= 14% headline (per OP-20 disclosure #1)
2. **Sample bias:** Stage-1 backtest will use 16 months of data (2025-01-02 to 2026-06-18) with walk-forward OOS held-out window (last 4 months). Selection method: parameter sweep over VIX threshold (15-25) with 0.5 increments. Overfit risk: mitigated by walk-forward validation and concentration disclosure.
3. **Out-of-sample:** NEEDS-OOS (will run walk-forward after Stage-1)
4. **Real-fills:** NEEDS-REAL-FILLS (will validate on top 3 J days after OOS)
5. **Failure modes:** 
   - Worst day: VIX spike during false breakdown (e.g., 5/06) causing missed winner if VIX>=20 filter too strict
   - Max drawdown: potential -$400 if filter causes consecutive losses on winner days
   - Blow-up scenario: persistent low-VIX regime (VIX<15) where filter blocks all entries, leading to zero P&L and opportunity cost
6. **Concentration:** unknown -- requires Stage-1 backtest (will compute top5_pct after backtest)
